title: USER: AWS account, Google OAuth client, allowed emails, deploy approval
description:
**For the user** (rap@endymion.com). Needed before anything in this epic can run:
1. An AWS profile and region for the Amplify sandbox (`npx ampx sandbox --profile … `).
2. A Google OAuth client (id and secret), stored as Amplify secrets `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` / `GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET`. Authorized redirect URI: the Cognito domain's `/oauth2/idpresponse`. Papyrus has a setup guide: `/Users/home/Projects/Papyrus/docs/google-oauth-setup.md`.
3. The allowed emails (`ALLOWED_EMAILS`).
4. Explicit approval to deploy a sandbox (it creates billable AWS resources).

Reply in a comment; the storage lead picks it up.
